snapshot_metadata.purpose: Pre-Story-4.5 default-disabled regression snapshot. Pipeline state with options.mlTechnique == nil AND options.ensemblePolicy == .dspOnly (defaults). Story 4.5 must produce byte-identical output against this baseline at default config (AC #5) and against any mlTechnique under .dspOnly (the A1 short-circuit). DSP behavior is unchanged from Story 4-4b (inertness contract holds) — the per-track byte-identity baseline at `Tests/BoomBoomBoomKitBenchmarkTests/Fixtures/4-3-baseline-bpms.json` (Story 4-3 capture, validated by `MLPolicySweepTests::dspOnlyMatchesStory4_3Baseline`) remains the canonical fixture for Story 4-5 as well.
snapshot_metadata.amendment_note: Per Story 4-5 AC #5: this metadata-only snapshot is informational; the test-enforceable byte-identity is the per-track BPM JSON pinned at `Tests/BoomBoomBoomKitBenchmarkTests/Fixtures/4-3-baseline-bpms.json` (82 OA300 tracks, bpmBits / confidenceBits as Double.bitPattern UInt64). Both `options.mlTechnique == nil` and `options.mlTechnique != nil + options.ensemblePolicy == .dspOnly` paths converge on this fixture because the A1 short-circuit prevents `MLTechnique.evaluate(trace:)` from being called.

The baseline was captured at Story 4-3 SHA and remains valid because DSP behavior is unchanged through Stories 4-3b, 4-4, 4-4b — and Story 4-5 must preserve this when ml.mlTechnique == nil (default) OR ensemblePolicy == .dspOnly (A1 short-circuit).
